subject: Re: Next steps & scope addendum — BlueHarbor POC (refunds + pricing guardrails)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wexler <tom.wexler@blueharbor.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor discovery recap + proposed POC plan

Tom / Priya — thanks again for a productive discussion today. Quick recap + next steps from the call so we have the same frame before we kick off the trial: 

High-level goal:
- Validate that Redwood inference can reliably extract refund & return intents from web chat transcripts and attach the correct refund reason to each case. Success here will let you automate initial routing and triage for refunds.

POC scope (proposed):
- Ingest: 30k anonymized chat transcripts (sample) from BlueHarbor — Redwood will provide ingest script & instructions.
- Use cases: primary = refund extraction (intent + reason), secondary = automated routing suggestion (3-class).
- Success criteria (initial): refund-intent precision >= 88% and recall >= 82% on the evaluation set; routing suggestion accuracy >= 80%.
- Timeline: 4 weeks (ingest + baseline + two evaluation sprints).
- Ownership: BlueHarbor to provide data and SME time; Redwood to run baseline models, build evaluation set, and produce metrics dashboard.

Proposed next steps:
1) BlueHarbor uploads a sample bundle (min 5k transcripts) and the schema for identifiers by Fri 9/3.
2) Redwood delivers baseline model run and initial dashboard by Tue 9/7.
3) Joint review call 9/8 to align on acceptance tweaks; finalize POC success rubric.

If you're aligned, I'll send an amended POC plan and updated acceptance spreadsheet. Also flagged two minor risks we discussed: PII redaction on transcripts and cases with multi-turn refund negotiation.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Tom Wexler <tom.wexler@blueharbor.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueharbor.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor discovery recap + proposed POC plan

Thanks Soojin — that captures it well. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- We can get you 5k transcripts by Friday; engineering will sanitize PII and drop any personally identifying fields.
- Priya and I discussed adding one mid-trial ask: can we try extracting "refund reason" categories (e.g., damaged, wrong item, buyer remorse) as structured output? That would be very helpful for routing to the right operations queue.
- On success criteria, can we push precision target to 90% if we can get two additional weeks for tuning? We want low false positives for refund routing.

If Redwood can add the structured reason extraction as an extra output and tolerate a 2-week extension to the overall POC timeline, we can commit to the sample upload on 9/3.

Tom
Tom Wexler
Senior Director, Customer Ops | BlueHarbor Retail
tom.wexler@blueharbor.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BlueHarbor discovery recap + proposed POC plan — request to add structured reason extraction

Folks — forwarding Tom's ask. BlueHarbor would like to add a structured "refund reason" classification to scope and is willing to extend the trial by two weeks.

Questions for alignment: 
- Dylan: can we accommodate the extra classification label set without blowing the baseline timeline? What change to acceptance thresholds would you recommend if we add a structured 5-way reason classifier?
- Lauren: can you confirm we have capacity in the evaluation dashboard to track per-label precision/recall and add the new sheets?

I'm tagging both of you as owners for those items so we can respond to Tom with a concrete amended plan today.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueHarbor discovery recap + proposed POC plan — request to add structured reason extraction

Short answer: yes, we can add it. Notes and impact: 

- Implementation: we'll add a 5-way classification head (damaged, wrong-item, buyer-remorse, size/fit, other). This is a low-risk change — same architecture, just extra labels.
- Data needs: BlueHarbor will need to annotate a small validation set with reason labels (we can do a lightweight tagging guide). Recommend at least 800 annotated examples across labels (stratified) for reliable per-label metrics.
- Timeline impact: +10 business days for a tuning round and metric stabilization. So total POC becomes 6 weeks instead of 4.
- Acceptance thresholds (proposed amended): 
  - refund-intent: precision >= 90% and recall >= 85% (we'll aim higher but set these as gates).
  - reason-classifier: macro-F1 >= 0.78 on the annotated eval set; no critical label should be under 0.65 F1.
  - routing suggestion: remain >= 80% accuracy.
- Deliverables: updated dashboard with per-label precision/recall/F1, model checkpoints for baseline & tuned runs, and an exportable confusion matrix sheet.

Lauren, if you can add the new sheets and a simple per-label dashboard by end of day, I can draft the technical appendix for the amended plan.

Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0124
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Amended POC plan & acceptance criteria — BlueHarbor (refunds + reason extraction)

Tom / Priya — following up with the amended plan we discussed and agreed internally. Attaching the short POC addendum and the acceptance spreadsheet so you have everything in one place. Summary of the changes below.

What changed (summary):
- Added: structured "refund reason" classifier (5 labels).
- Timeline: extended to 6 weeks total (originally 4). Key milestones: sample upload by 9/3 -> baseline run by 9/8 -> annotation + tuning window 9/9–9/22 -> final evaluation 9/24 -> wrap / lessons 9/28.
- Acceptance gates (finalized): refund-intent precision >= 90% & recall >= 85%; reason-classifier macro-F1 >= 0.78 (no label < 0.65); routing suggestion accuracy >= 80%.
- Data requirements: BlueHarbor to produce 800 annotated reason labels (we'll provide template and guide).
- Deliverables: BH-POC-amended-plan-v2.pdf, POC-success-metrics.xlsx, network-diagram.png (attached).

Next concrete asks for BlueHarbor:
1) Upload the 5k sanitized sample bundle to the Drive folder by EOD 9/3.
2) Identify two SMEs for annotation questions and a single technical contact for S3/ingest.

If that works, we'll treat this as the baseline scope and start the ingest on 9/4. Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow if you want to walk through the amended plan.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: BH-POC-amended-plan-v2.pdf (application/pdf), POC-success-metrics.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), network-diagram.png (image/png)
summary: Post-discovery thread where BlueHarbor requests adding a structured refund-reason classifier mid-POC. Redwood agrees with a +10 business day extension, updates acceptance criteria (higher precision/recall for intent; macro-F1 for reason classifier), assigns internal owners, and requests sample upload and annotated examples.
